video_title: Yaxel Lendeborg and Al Horford Interviewed assessing warriors situation without Steph Curry-BbMarnz

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on his evolving role without Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: I have to be a lot more aggressive. Definitely have to be more in the scorer mindset now.
quotes.quote: I have to be a lot more aggressive. Definitely have to be more in the scorer mindset now. My mindset so far has been just supporting Steph. Now it is more so this is more supporting Steph than ever, but just more aggressively, I guess you can say. Some can say Steph is absent. I don't know. We will see how it goes. I know me and BP are going to do a lot of extra scoring now.
quotes.social_post: Yaxel Lendeborg says he is shifting into a more aggressive scorer mindset with Steph Curry out. He notes that he and Brandin Podziemski will need to pick up the extra scoring load for the Warriors.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on adjusting to defensive pressure without Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: Once I beat that person, you see three people flying at you.
quotes.quote: There was way more gap help. My man was on me. He is a great, great defender. Trying not to play too much with the ball while he is guarding me and trying to get a switch on somebody that I like. Once I beat that person, you see three people flying at you. So now it is all going to be just on how good our spacing is eventually. This game is going to be a lot different because Wemby is in there.
quotes.social_post: Yaxel Lendeborg on facing defensive pressure without Steph Curry: Once I beat my man, you see three people flying at you. It is all going to be about how good our spacing is.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on Draymond Green's mentorship and mindset
quotes.excerpt: He is always telling me to stay myself, stay myself and be aggressive as much as I can.
quotes.quote: He is always telling me to stay myself, stay myself and be aggressive as much as I can. Last game I had a bad airball in the second half. I was down about it. He was saying just good shot, keep shooting. Trying to hype me up and I really appreciate that from him. I try to talk to him before the game starts just to hear his insight, but I haven't heard nothing yet.
quotes.social_post: Yaxel Lendeborg credits Draymond Green for his mentorship, saying Draymond encourages him to stay aggressive even after a bad airball. He says he tries to talk to him before games for insight.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on shifting to an alpha dog mentality
quotes.excerpt: I do have to start thinking more like an alpha dog rather than beta.
quotes.quote: I am coming into this league as a new guy. I don't really feel like I am one of the best at all, especially with how much is going on in the outside perspective. But the way he put it, maybe I could have been, or maybe just that game. But in general, I do have to start thinking more like an alpha dog rather than beta. That is why I do need to talk to Draymond a lot more because he kind of helps shift as quickly as possible.
quotes.social_post: Yaxel Lendeborg says he needs to shift his mentality to be more of an alpha dog on the court. He admits he is still learning to navigate the league as a new guy.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on preparing for Victor Wembanyama's defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: He is going to be in help a lot.
quotes.quote: Well, he has five blocks. He is going to be in help a lot. And obviously, you see all the stats that he has put up. The most recent was like 52 and 24. That is crazy. So, you know me, I am going to try to shoot as many threes as I can tonight and try to bait him into helping, maybe we get some more kick-outs.
quotes.social_post: Yaxel Lendeborg on preparing for Victor Wembanyama: I am going to try to shoot as many threes as I can tonight and try to bait him into helping, maybe we get some more kick-outs.

quotes.speaker: Al Horford
quotes.summary_phrase: Al Horford on the defensive necessity without Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: I think we have to really lean in on our defense.
quotes.quote: I think we have to really lean in on our defense. Defense has to be really good. And we have to make sure that we all just step up a little more on the offensive. Obviously, Steph is a big part of what we do, but we just all have to do a little more.
quotes.social_post: Al Horford says the team must lean into their defense and step up collectively on offense while Steph Curry is sidelined.

quotes.speaker: Al Horford
quotes.summary_phrase: Al Horford on the unique challenges posed by Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: Very unique, just all the problems that he presents, playing not only inside but outside as well.
quotes.quote: Very unique, just all the problems that he presents, playing not only inside but outside as well. And defensively, the challenges that he presents as well. So we have to make sure that we do a good job as a team, really trying to contain him and really making him take tough shots.
quotes.social_post: Al Horford on the challenge of facing Victor Wembanyama: He is very unique with all the problems he presents inside and outside. We have to do a good job as a team containing him.

quotes.speaker: Al Horford
quotes.summary_phrase: Al Horford on maintaining paint presence against Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: You have to know when to attack, what's a good shot, and when to kick it out.
quotes.quote: You have to know when to attack, what's a good shot, and when to kick it out and how to get paint touches. So we are probably not going to get many of them on the first drive, so it is going to take probably a second or third effort to get that done.
quotes.social_post: Al Horford on attacking the paint against Wembanyama: You are probably not going to get many paint touches on the first drive, so it is going to take a second or third effort to get that done.

quotes.speaker: Al Horford
quotes.summary_phrase: Al Horford on supporting Yaxel Lendeborg's elevated role
quotes.excerpt: He doesn't need any added pressure. I just think we need to go out there and help him.
quotes.quote: Just making sure that he continues to do what he has been doing. I feel like this year he has come on and taken on the responsibility and just going out there and playing. He doesn't need any added pressure. I just think we need to go out there and help him the best way that we can and we all just have to step up and do a little more.
quotes.social_post: Al Horford on Yaxel Lendeborg taking on more responsibility: He does not need any added pressure. We just need to go out there and help him the best way that we can.

quotes.speaker: Al Horford
quotes.summary_phrase: Al Horford on Yaxel Lendeborg's immediate impact as a rookie
quotes.excerpt: He is one of those rookies that he has kind of come in and been able to have an impact.
quotes.quote: He is one of those rookies that he has kind of come in and been able to have an impact right away on the offensive end in a way that it is hard for a rookie to do that. And he is doing it. His presence is felt. I know obviously we know that Steph is out, but I just think that for him this is just another game to come out, to be aggressive, to play his game.
quotes.social_post: Al Horford praises rookie Yaxel Lendeborg: He has been able to have an impact right away on the offensive end in a way that is hard for a rookie to do.

quotes.speaker: Al Horford
quotes.summary_phrase: Al Horford on Frank Vogel's meticulous coaching approach
quotes.excerpt: He is very detail-oriented. It is something that he is really enforcing a lot of the concepts.
quotes.quote: He is very detail-oriented. It is something that he is really enforcing a lot of the concepts that he wants us to do. And he is very meticulous on us being in the right position and in the right place, the right time, and making sure that the rotations are crisp. So the communication has been really good from him and we are all very comfortable with what he is telling us, what he is asking of us.
quotes.social_post: Al Horford describes Frank Vogel as very detail-oriented and meticulous about positioning and crisp rotations.
